correctness.rationale: On a chart setting one nonmissing coordinate to 1, the other two are independent involutions; the charts cover because no nonmissing coordinate can vanish at a geometric point. Different missing indices have disjoint supports, and the rings are free over Z, giving the schematic closures and their ranks. If i≠j, normalize both factors on one common coordinate: the incidence is x+y=0 for the signs on the other common coordinate, leaving three involution variables. If i=j, eliminate s from 1+r+s=0, r²=s²=1: 1+2r=0 and r+2=0 imply 3=0 and r=s=1. Conversely these values solve the relations over F3, leaving two independent signs and giving the diagonal there. This proves the full decomposition, not just point counts. In characteristic 2 all involution variables are 1 plus an independent square-zero variable; fixing a geometric plane leaves one such variable in each of the other three blocks, and no same-index incidence. Expanding the two squares verifies the special fibers, and (J+I)²=I over F2 and the F3 gradient verify quadric smoothness. The ordinary-characteristic marked geometry also checks directly: the gradient equations force exactly three nonzero equal-square coordinates; in the chart at [1:1:1:0] the quadratic part is -4u²-4v²+4uv+3w² with determinant 36. On the corresponding plane X0+X1+X2=0 the quartic restricts to -(X0²+X0X1+X1²-X3²)². Signs and permutations give the other cases. An independent enumeration of all 256 dot products of normalized sign representatives confirmed eight zeros per distinct-index pair of blocks and four additional, exactly diagonal, pairs per same-index block modulo 3.

value.rationale: The invariant is attached to a distinguished primitive self-dual quartic and its natural marked closures. The calculation pinpoints nonflat incidence even at a prime where both marked sets individually remain reduced and distinct, and resolves the different F2 phenomenon at scheme level, including the fixed-plane curvilinear lengths. These data are useful for specialization of the marked configuration; they cannot be read off from the generic (16_6) table or obtained by counting sign supports in residue fields alone.
